adjudication.rationale: The finding points to a real edge case in the diff. Looking at lines 1053-1060, when `eventType.destinationCalendar` is null/undefined and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is also null/undefined, `evt.destinationCalendar` becomes `null`. Then at line 1078, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining, which means if `destinationCalendar` is null, the push silently does nothing and cohost destination calendars are dropped. This is a valid edge case concern - the code should initialize an empty array when both are null to ensure team destination calendars can be added. However, this is more of a missing test/edge case coverage issue rather than a definite bug, as the finding specifically mentions 'No collective-booking test covers' this scenario.
